Work Product created in the course of the project is the property of Client throughout.
findings.explanation: The contract makes the work product the client's property during creation rather than upon full payment, leaving you unprotected if the client fails to pay.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Work Product shall remain with the Contractor until the Client has made all payments due under this Agreement.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a change before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause stating that the work product is the property of the client throughout, this assigns ownership during creation rather than upon full payment, leaving the work unprotected if payment is not made. I propose the following modification: Ownership of the Work Product shall remain with the Contractor until the Client has made all payments due under this Agreement. Best regards,
